blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The witness presented by the defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte on Thursday said that the Cale88 Foods Corp. linked to her spouse, Manases Carpio, has “red flags.” This was revealed during the clarificatory questions of Senator-judge Risa Hontiveros to defense witness Reinel dela Fuente, a former investigator with the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Secretariat-Compliance and Investigation Group. READ: Pangilinan notes Cale88 ownership change after P1.25B in transactions Hontiveros noted that the AMLC previously revealed that total bank inflows to Cale88 reached P776.64 million, while the firm declared only P208.49 million in sales with the Bureau of Internal Revenue.
